name: IC 511, SN 2017cfd field (Hubble)
blurb: IC 511, a galaxy that hosted the Type Ia supernova SN 2017cfd, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2017cfd-hubble
story: Here SN 2017cfd, a normal Type Ia supernova, was caught very young, within days of its first light. Hubble later returned to look at the site once the glow had faded.

claims.text: SN 2017cfd is a normal Type Ia supernova in IC 0511, discovered very young
